Honda m6: Insight d591) and a clear error for a scenario model with no id; the result count read from the \\u0027N vehicles found\\u0027 line; detail links matched on https://www.cargurus.com/details/\\u003Cdigits\\u003E and canonicalized without the query string; a card whose link carries sponsoredType=PRIORITY is skipped as sponsored; result pages are followed until the count is covered or a page adds no new link (verify the page parameter on a recorded page, the site scrolls to load more, so follow whichever it uses); proven by URL-building and link-collection tests over a recorded search page\u0022,\u0022Each card\\u0027s text yields the posting\\u0027s price, its fee posture (the card line \\u0027Price includes fees\\u0027 is all-in; \\u0027Price includes \\u003Camount\\u003E shipping\\u0027 is all-in with that amount stored as ShippingFee; no such line is unknown), and its deal badge (Great, Good, Fair, High, Overpriced Deal) as a posting attribute; the detail page yields the VIN (also present in the results page\\u0027s embedded listing JSON, which may serve as a cross-check), year, model, mileage, and the dealer name and city; the walk\\u0027s usual pacing, recording, and challenge pause apply; proven by extraction tests over fixtures cut from recorded pages\u0022,\u0022A single-model live walk (odo walk cargurus --model \\u0027Honda Insight\\u0027, the model with the largest measured gap) is run by the owner at the keyboard after merge as this task\\u0027s acceptance check, with its saved, dropped, and new-to-the-ledger counts pasted into the pull request; docs/walk.md gains a CarGurus subsection (URL shape and ids, the year parameter, sponsored cards, fee lines, badges); the run skill is not touched; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; the probe record is in ideas/adf5634b-site-specific-logic-for-each-walk-site-use-each-site-s-own-f/workspace/journal.md): with distance 50, startYear, and maxMileage applied, CarGurus lists 67 Prius, 97 Corolla Hybrid, 50 Camry Hybrid, and 21 Insight near 32833; of 78 VINs sampled from the first pages (all within 50 miles), 43 were not on the 308-vehicle ledger (Prius 7 of 18, Corolla Hybrid 4 of 19, Camry Hybrid 15 of 20, Insight 17 of 21). The Camry figure is inflated by today\\u0027s per-pair cap on the other sites; the Insight and Prius figures are real coverage. Verified facts: the year parameter is startYear (minYear, minModelYear, and yearMin are ignored); the page prints \\u00272019 - 2026\\u0027 as a chip when it applies; cards print \\u0027Price includes fees\\u0027 or \\u0027Price includes 702 dollars shipping\\u0027 style lines and deal badges; the page offers a filter \\u0027Only show listings that include dealer fees\\u0027; no bot challenge on about fifteen loads; the ids came from Brian\\u0027s own searches in the debugging Edge. Code: the Autotrader (PR #44) and CarMax (0b4e7f35) sites are the templates in src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSites.cs; card text per link from PR #51; FeePosture and ShippingFee columns and the attributes table from c7313844; the fee-statement reader from 6ec168cf and the badge reader from 45f16b00 should be extended rather than duplicated, so this task is ordered after them by its blocker chain.
